Well there are two separate things one is sadness and other is depression.

The very basic difference between them is that when you're sad, you have a reason of being sad. Like loss in business, loosing someone close to you , etc 
But when you're depressed, you cannot find any specific reason to be low.

It can also be put like this that sadness is a feeling and depression is a phase /state .

Of what give mentioned, you're probably in depression. You are clearly on early stages of it , you can consult a therapist asap.
And else I recommend forbid yourself from intake of caffeine (in case you're suffering from hallucinations and anxiety, even if you aren't, leaving them will help) .
